title: Rate-Agnostic Wald Inference for Dyadic Regressions
abstract: arXiv:2609.16968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops Wald inference for least-squares estimation of linear regression models on dyadic data, accommodating configurations where multiple observations share the same pair of units (e.g., directed flows, multilayer networks, and dyadic panels). We establish that the dyadic-robust Wald statistic is asymptotically $\chi^2_q$ for an arbitrary nonrandom sequence of full-rank restrictions, under a single condition on the accumulation of dependence. Throughout, no convergence rate is assumed or estimated, permitting the condition number of the score's variance matrix to diverge. We further propose a delete-one-unit jackknife alternative that is positive semidefinite by construction. This jackknife statistic attains the same asymptotic limit under one additional condition on dyad multiplicity and remains asymptotically conservative when that condition fails. translated_title: 二元数据回归的速率无关Wald推断
translated_abstract: 本文针对二元数据上线性回归模型的最小二乘估计发展了Wald推断方法，适用于多个观测共享同一单位对的情形（如有向流、多层网络和二元面板数据）。在关于依赖性累积的单一条件下，我们证明了二元稳健Wald统计量对于任意非随机的满秩约束序列渐近服从 $\chi^2_q$ 分布。整个过程不假设或估计任何收敛速率，允许得分方差矩阵的条件数发散。我们进一步提出了一种删除单个单位的刀切法替代方案，该方法在构造上是半正定的。在关于二元组多重性的额外条件下，该刀切统计量达到相同的渐近极限；当该条件不满足时，它仍然保持渐近保守。补充材料包含所有证明以及以估计量为特色的蒙特卡洛实验。
tldr: 本文为二元数据回归提出了速率无关的Wald推断方法，在单一依赖性条件下证明了二元稳健Wald统计量的渐近卡方分布性质，并提出了一种构造上半正定的删除单个单位刀切法替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper develops rate-agnostic Wald inference for dyadic regressions, establishing the asymptotic chi-squared property of the dyadic-robust Wald statistic under a single dependence condition and proposing a positive semidefinite delete-one-unit jackknife alternative.
